mira (PM): ok team — we need to lock the launch checklist for the "action result" surface. customer asks are piling up; want clear criteria and a migration plan. quick sync? :wave:
sanjay (Eng): 👍 outline please. key infra stuff: backward compat, error semantics, and telemetry hooks.
eli (Eng-ML): add quality/regression detection for structured outputs. small schema drift can be dangerous.
cassie (Design): also need UX error shapes (what the app sees when a tool fails). examples for dev portal.
ana (Customer-Success): we have 3 customers asking for: deterministic result id, partial-progress events, and rich error codes so they can map to retry/non-retry behavior. they expect an SDK helper.
mira (PM): summary proposal: 1) stable envelope with fields {result_id, status, output, metadata, error} 2) defined status set: success|partial|failed|timeout 3) telemetry events for request, result, and fallback 4) migration - default on for new customers, opt-in toggle for existing during canary 5) rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error budget breaches.
sanjay (Eng): implementation notes: prefer snake_case in JSON to match existing APIs. we must keep old freeform tool call result as fallback (text-only). also need to decide: should we require schema validation server-side or let SDK validate client-side? server-side validation costs CPU for all calls.
eli (Eng-ML): server-side lightweight validation (presence + types) + optional strict mode for customers who register a schema. strict mode emits regression alerts when outputs deviate. metrics: schema-violation-rate, mean tokens, failed_invocations_per_min.
cassie (Design): example error shapes for dev portal and UI suggestions:
```
{
  "status": "failed",
  "error": {"code":"TOOL_TIMEOUT","message":"gpu queue timeout","retryable":true}
}
```
nana (Customer-Success): customers want deterministic result_id so they can dedupe. suggest `result_id = sha256(request_id + tool_name + timestamp)` or we can provide server-generated uuid. which do we prefer?
sanjay (Eng): server-generated UUID is safest. avoid making clients compute hashes; simpler for idempotency mapping. We should also include a server timestamp.
mira (PM): ok server-uuid + server-timestamp. next: partial/streamed results. some tools stream incremental outputs (progress updates, partial matches). proposal: streaming frames with `status: partial` then final `status: success` or `failed`. Agree?
eli (Eng-ML): yes — ensure KV-cache semantics for streaming: intermediate frames must be replayable for debugging. add `frame_index` and `parent_result_id`.
sanjay (Eng): streaming impacts routing and concurrency limits. we can reuse our existing streaming path but must add `frame_index` and `is_final` flags. also need backpressure rules in SDK.
cassie (Design): UX guidance: show partials as progressively richer cards, but only if frame confidence > threshold. we should include `confidence` in metadata.
mira (PM): launch gating checklist draft (for this feature):
- API schema spec published on docs (samples + error codes)
- server-side minimal validation implemented
- SDK helpers for JS + Python (createResult, onPartial, onFinal, fallback)
- telemetry: request/result events + schema_violation metric + sample payload capture (PII redaction)
- canary plan + rollback criteria defined (error budget, schema_violation > 0.5%)
- migration comms + sample code snippets for customers
- QA: fuzz tests with malformed tool outputs + integration tests with Dedicated infra
- accessibility/UX review of error states
sanjay (Eng): add load test: 5x expected request rate with 10% streaming frames. if any tail latency > SLO, hold launch. also quantify CPU overhead for validation.
eli (Eng-ML): add automated quality checks: run 1k sample prompts against new envelope, compute distribution shift vs baseline using KL on categorical fields and token-diff on text fields. alert if drift > threshold.
nana (Customer-Success): can we provide a migration toggle per-tenant? some customers want to test for a week with traffic split.
sanjay (Eng): yes, feature flag per-tenant. implement via config layer; prefer server-side toggle so SDKs don't have to change on the fly.
mira (PM): acceptance criteria for beta:
- docs + spec live
- JS + Python SDKs have stable helpers (no beta API changes during canary)
- telemetry events flowing and visible in Console per-tenant
- two customer pilots completed with no major regressions
- rollback playbook and runbook added to eng-oncall channel
- sign-off from Eng, Eng-ML, Design, CustSuccess
cassie (Design): we'll draft sample cards & error illustrations by EOD Wed.
eli (Eng-ML): I'll wire the drift checks and add telem alerts. need samples from product.
sanjay (Eng): I'll spike server validation and per-tenant flag. can we aim for canary next sprint?
mira (PM): timeline proposal: spec + docs this week, SDK spikes next, canary in 3 weeks if all green.
nana (Customer-Success): I'll line up 2 pilot customers and prepare comms template (breaking changes, opt-in instructions).
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: infra-canary/1978245610 to prod-canary at 1978245800 (automated)
mira (PM): cool — next actions: 1) sanjay: PR for validation + flag 2) eli: metrics + drift check stub 3) cassie: UX mocks 4) ana: pilot outreach. update thread when PRs land. :raised_hands:
sanjay (Eng): noted. starting spike now.
eli (Eng-ML): copied test harness into eng-ml repo. will share soon.
cassie (Design): will post mock images here when ready.
nana (Customer-Success): sending pilot invite drafts by EOD.
mira (PM): thanks all — good progress. we'll reconvene after the canary rollout check. :rocket:
